Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side:

- FinPath is evaluating an LLM inference platform primarily for customer-facing assistant and document summarization.
- Key requirements: sub-200ms tail latency for interactive flows, strict data isolation for PII, and vendor support for SOC2 / KMS integration.
- Main stakeholders: Product (you), Security (Ava?), Procurement (Liam?).

Next steps I propose:
1) Technical deep-dive/demo (30–45m) with our runtime team to walk architecture, SSO/KMS, and performance tuning.
2) Share a short RFI + SOW draft so your team can circulate with security/procurement.

Proposed demo slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 24 — 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Nov 25 — 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu Nov 26 — 11:00–11:45am

If those don't work, share a couple of windows and I can pull in our infra lead. I’m looping in our pre-sales engineer (Dev Patel) and solutions partner (Logan Wright) on the next reply so they can lead the technical deep-dive if we lock a time.

Attached: Redwood_RFI_FinPath_fillable.pdf (fillable RFI to get the security/procurement questions started). Also attaching a high-level SOW draft for scope/estimates.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.
